'''Moonus Mandel''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Bothan Space/Legends|Bothan sector]], and the homeworld of the [[Veknoid/Legends|Veknoid]] species.

==History==
In [[58 BBY/Legends|58 BBY]], during the [[Mandalorian Civil War (True Mandalorians)|Mandalorian Civil War]], [[Tor Vizsla|Vizsla]] planned to conquer Moonus Mandel following the [[Battle of Concord Dawn]].<ref name="Jango Fett: Open Seasons">''[[Star Wars: Jango Fett: Open Seasons]]''</ref> The planet remained neutral during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="FF139">{{FactFile|139|WOR 1-2|Worlds of the Clone Wars}}</ref>

Moonus Mandel was the homeworld of [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] pilot [[Teemto Pagalies/Legends|Teemto Pagalies]].<ref name="Databank">{{DB|character|teemtopagalies|Pagalies, Teemto}}</ref>
